related_questions.question: What should I avoid while taking lisinopril?

text_blocks.snippet: When taking lisinopril, it's crucial to avoid certain medications, foods, and activities to ensure safety and effectiveness. Avoid NSAIDs like ibuprofen and naproxen, high-potassium foods and salt substitutes, alcohol, and excessive sun exposure. Additionally, be cautious with activities requiring alertness due to potential dizziness, and inform your doctor about any pregnancy plans.
snippet_highlighted_words: Avoid NSAIDs like ibuprofen and naproxen, high-potassium foods and salt substitutes, alcohol, and excessive sun exposure

list.title: Other Medications:
list.snippet: Avoid taking lisinopril with certain medications like NSAIDs (ibuprofen, naproxen), renin inhibitors (aliskiren), and some heart failure medications (sacubitril/valsartan) due to potential interactions.

list.title: High-Potassium Foods and Salt Substitutes:
list.snippet: Lisinopril can increase potassium levels, so avoid excessive consumption of foods like bananas, oranges, potatoes, and squash, and be cautious with salt substitutes.

list.title: Alcohol:
list.snippet: Alcohol can worsen dizziness and drowsiness caused by lisinopril, so it's best to avoid or limit alcohol intake.

list.title: Excessive Sun Exposure:
list.snippet: Lisinopril can increase sensitivity to sunlight, so use sunscreen, protective clothing, and avoid tanning beds.

list.title: Activities Requiring Alertness:
list.snippet: Be mindful of potential dizziness or lightheadedness, especially when standing up quickly, and avoid activities like driving or operating machinery until you know how lisinopril affects you.

list.title: Pregnancy:
list.snippet: Lisinopril can harm a developing fetus, so inform your doctor if you are pregnant or plan to become pregnant.

list.title: Certain Cough, Cold, or Pain Medications:
list.snippet: Avoid taking over-the-counter medications for coughs, colds, or pain without consulting your doctor, as some ingredients may interact with lisinopril.

list.title: Other Medications with Similar Effects:
list.snippet: Avoid taking lisinopril with mTOR inhibitors (sirolimus, everolimus) as it can increase the risk of angioedema.

list.title: Monitor Kidney Function:
list.snippet: Your doctor will monitor your kidney function, especially when starting lisinopril or when combined with other medications like NSAIDs.

list.title: Monitor Potassium Levels:
list.snippet: Your doctor will also monitor your potassium levels, as lisinopril can cause them to increase.

list.title: Consult Your Doctor:
list.snippet: Always consult with your doctor or pharmacist before starting any new medication or making significant changes to your diet or activity while taking lisinopril.
